nurture talent: A good coach knows how to nurture talent, giving young players both practice time and confidence to grow.
好的教練懂得培育人才，給年輕球員練習時間與成長的信心。
nurture a relationship: To nurture a relationship with old friends, you need to call them and spend time together regularly.
要經營與老朋友的關係，你需要定期打電話給他們並一起相處。
nurture a dream: Her parents helped her nurture a dream of becoming a pianist by paying for lessons for ten years.
她的父母花十年支付課程費用，幫助她呵護成為鋼琴家的夢想。
nature versus nurture: Scientists still argue about nature versus nurture: is intelligence decided by our genes or by how we are raised?
科學家仍在爭論先天與後天：智力是由基因決定，還是由我們的成長方式決定？
object to the plan: Many neighbors object to the plan to build a factory next to the elementary school because of pollution.
許多鄰居反對在小學旁邊蓋工廠的計畫，因為會有汙染。
object strongly: The students object strongly to the new rule that bans cell phones during lunch break.
學生們強烈反對禁止在午休時間使用手機的新規定。
no one objected: When the teacher suggested a class trip to the beach, no one objected, and everyone cheered happily.
當老師提議全班去海邊旅行時，無人反對，大家都開心地歡呼。
obscure the truth: The company tried to obscure the truth about the accident by hiding important reports from the public.
那家公司把重要報告藏起來不讓大眾知道，試圖掩蓋事故的真相。
obscure the view: The tall new building will obscure the view of the mountains that we used to enjoy from our balcony.
那棟新的高樓會擋住我們以前在陽台上欣賞的山景視線。
obscure the issue: Shouting at each other will only obscure the issue, so let's calmly focus on the real problem.
互相吼叫只會模糊議題，所以我們冷靜下來專注在真正的問題上吧。
an obscure writer: Before his novel became a bestseller, he was an obscure writer whose books few people had ever read.
在他的小說成為暢銷書之前，他是個默默無聞的作家，很少人讀過他的書。
observe the rules: All players must observe the rules of the game, or the referee will send them off the field.
所有球員都必須遵守比賽規定，否則裁判會把他們罰出場。
observe a holiday: Families who strictly observe a holiday like Yom Kippur do not eat, drink, or work for a whole day.
嚴格過贖罪日這類節日的家庭，一整天都不吃、不喝也不工作。
observe a minute of silence: Before the game began, the crowd stood up to observe a minute of silence for the victims of the earthquake.
比賽開始前，觀眾起立為地震罹難者默哀一分鐘。
observe behavior: Scientists spent months in the forest to observe behavior of wild monkeys and take careful notes.
科學家在森林裡待了好幾個月，觀察野生猴子的行為並仔細做筆記。
observe that: Visitors often observe that the old classroom looks exactly the same as it did fifty years ago.
參觀者常評論道，這間老教室看起來和五十年前一模一樣。
observe a tradition: Every New Year's Eve, our family likes to observe a tradition of eating dinner together and giving red envelopes.
每年除夕，我們家喜歡遵循一起吃年夜飯和發紅包的傳統。
obtain permission: Students must obtain permission from their parents before they can join the overnight school trip.
學生必須先獲得家長的許可，才能參加學校的過夜旅行。
obtain information: Reporters tried to obtain information about the accident from the police, but the officers refused to comment.
記者們試圖從警方取得有關那場事故的資訊，但警員拒絕發表評論。
obtain a degree: After six years of studying at night, she was finally able to obtain a degree in law and become a lawyer.
在夜間讀了六年書之後，她終於取得法律學位並成為律師。
obtain results: The scientists repeated the experiment many times in order to obtain results they could trust.
科學家們重複實驗很多次，以獲得他們可以信任的結果。
occupy a position: She is the first woman to occupy a position as manager in this traditional company.
她是第一位在這家傳統公司擔任經理職位的女性。
occupy one's time: After he retired, my grandfather began painting and gardening to occupy his time.
退休後，我祖父開始畫畫和園藝來占用他的時間。
occupy the mind: Worries about the coming exam can occupy the mind so much that students cannot relax on weekends.
對即將到來的考試的擔憂會占據心思，讓學生週末都無法放鬆。
occupy a city: In the war, the enemy army planned to occupy a city near the border and control the whole area.
戰爭中，敵軍計畫占領一座靠近邊境的城市，並控制整個地區。
be occupied with work: My mother is so occupied with work this month that she rarely has time to cook dinner for us.
我媽媽這個月忙於工作，幾乎沒時間幫我們煮晚餐。
occupy the top spot: Her new song may occupy the top spot on the music chart for many weeks because everyone loves it.
她的新歌可能會在音樂排行榜上占據第一名好幾週，因為大家都很喜歡。
offend someone: Using rude words at a dinner party can easily offend someone, even if you are only joking.
在晚宴上說粗魯的話很容易冒犯某人，即使你只是在開玩笑。
offend against the law: People who offend against the law by selling fake medicine will be fined and may go to prison.
販賣假藥而觸法的人會被罰款，甚至可能入獄。
be easily offended: My uncle is easily offended, so be careful not to make jokes about his job at dinner.
我叔叔很容易生氣，所以晚餐時小心別拿他的工作開玩笑。
offend the eye: The piles of garbage along the river offend the eye and make the whole town look dirty.
河邊成堆的垃圾有礙觀瞻，讓整個城鎮看起來很髒亂。
